param: σ Progression rate from Exposed to Infectious. The average latent period is 2/σ.
γ Progression/recovery rate from Infectious to Recovered. The average infectious period is 2/γ.
π Initial proportion of the population that is susceptible.
ψ Exponential Growth Rate (EGR) of the epidemic at its start.
p_ICU Probability of ICU admission given infection.
μ_ICU|E Mean time from exposure to ICU admission.
σ²_ICU|E Variance of the time from exposure to ICU admission.
